title: Sparkly lemon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lemonGrad' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='75%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff59a'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffe23d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8b800'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='shineGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- lemon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='30' ry='24' fill='url(#lemonGrad)'/>
  <!-- pointed tip left -->
  <path d='M22 58 Q18 54 20 50 Q24 53 24 56 Z' fill='#e8b800'/>
  <!-- pointed tip right -->
  <path d='M78 50 Q82 54 80 58 Q76 55 76 52 Z' fill='#e8b800'/>
  <!-- end dot left -->
  <circle cx='21' cy='53' r='2.2' fill='#c9a000'/>
  <!-- end dot right -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='53' r='2.2' fill='#c9a000'/>

  <!-- shading edge bottom -->
  <path d='M25 62 Q50 82 75 62 Q50 74 25 62 Z' fill='#d9a800' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='43' rx='9' ry='5.5' fill='url(#shineGrad)' transform='rotate(-20 40 43)'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <!-- sparkle top-left star -->
    <path d='M20 20 L22 26 L28 28 L22 30 L20 36 L18 30 L12 28 L18 26 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle top-right star -->
    <path d='M80 18 L81.5 22.5 L86 24 L81.5 25.5 L80 30 L78.5 25.5 L74 24 L78.5 22.5 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom-left -->
    <path d='M24 78 L25.5 82 L29.5 83.5 L25.5 85 L24 89 L22.5 85 L18.5 83.5 L22.5 82 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom-right -->
    <path d='M76 76 L77.5 80 L81.5 81.5 L77.5 83 L76 87 L74.5 83 L70.5 81.5 L74.5 80 Z'/>
    <!-- small dots -->
    <circle cx='52' cy='16' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='48' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='52' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='90' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='14' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='12' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- warm glow sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffd84d'>
    <circle cx='44' cy='88' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='70' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='72' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
